You can set the monitor to do 10 Bit 165 Hz in HDR mode and SDR by creating a custom resolution in GPU settings:
Set resolution to 3440x1440, and set the refresh rate to 165Hz. --> Set timing config to Manual ---> Set "Total Pixels" or "Timing Total" (AMD) to 3520 for Horizontal, and 1475 for Vertical.
